items.quote: Cyko spearheaded teamwork across departments on the annual review at the national level.
Cyko Fenuen championed the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Cyko Fenuen led dashboards tracking service performance metrics across the department.
He championed policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Cyko led prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff across the department.
Cyko Fenuen handled delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak competently within his team.
Cyko championed stakeholder consultations for the licensing review and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He headed the organisational restructuring of the department, setting priorities for several teams.
He took ownership of an end-to-end review of the service ecosystem and steered it to completion.
Cyko managed financial controls for the grant scheme for his unit.
He was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of the five-year strategic plan for the division.
